admin.guide.tool_install: Install skills, rules, and other folders. Stdio writes locally; HTTP returns a tarball URL for the AI to extract.
admin.guide.tool_update: Update an existing install. Same version is idempotent. HTTP returns a tarball URL plus instructions.

mcp.tools.sdd_list_versions: framework.sdd.works: list available framework package versions and high-level inventory (skills/rules/other) from the Settings GitHub source. Read-only. Never returns key values. Failures: package_unavailable.
mcp.tools.sdd_get_key: framework.sdd.works: return plaintext key_value for key_name from the admin key store. Auth required on HTTP (same bearer as transport). Failures: not_found, unauthorized. Does not leak other key names.
mcp.tools.sdd_install_framework: framework.sdd.works: install framework package. Stdio writes local paths directly. HTTP always returns packageUrl + paths + manifest + instructions for AI shell extraction (never already_up_to_date — verify local files before skipping curl|tar). Optional force=true. Failures: path_rejected, client_unknown, package_unavailable, sync_pending.
mcp.tools.sdd_update_framework: framework.sdd.works: update an existing install. Alias of sdd_install_framework. Stdio writes locally; HTTP returns packageUrl + instructions for AI extraction (never already_up_to_date). Optional force=true. Failures: path_rejected, package_unavailable, sync_pending.
